title: An EmDash agent's pre-warm also warms the site's MCP road (one read-only call that needs no argument), on a log line of its own; other CMSes never exec
steps: S1: Create an agent on an EmDash site whose browser said hello, with an exec that records its input.
S2: The same on a WordPress site.
expect: S1: the two door reads as before, and one exec whose stdin is tools/call schema_list_collections with no argument; an answer it cannot read is one warning of its own.
evidence: bench v7 (todo-agent-v7.md): an EmDash agent's first MCP call after a container start paid 20–40 s; the pre-warm read only through the Apply door, which EmDash reads do not use
fence: The pre-warm stays a courtesy: not awaited, at most once per site per five minutes, a failure is one log line

tests: an EmDash agent also warms the site's MCP road
a warm that fails is one log line
